title: Experiment
description: A single experiment represents a complete biological assay or reaction study, capturing all the essential components and parameters needed to reproduce and analyze the experimental results. Each experiment serves as a discrete unit of scientific investigation with defined inputs, conditions, and measurable outcomes.

conditions.title: conditions
conditions.description: Environmental parameters under which the experiment is conducted

description.title: description
description.description: Detailed description of the experimental procedure, objectives, and expected outcomes

enzymes.title: enzymes
enzymes.description: Array of all enzymes used as catalysts in the experiment

molecules.title: molecules
molecules.description: Array of all chemical compounds involved in the reaction (substrates, products, cofactors, inhibitors)

name.title: name
name.description: A unique identifier or descriptive name for the experiment

Conditions.title: Conditions
Conditions.description: Conditions encompass the critical environmental and physical parameters that govern the experimental setup and directly influence enzyme activity, reaction kinetics, and overall experimental outcomes. These parameters must be carefully controlled and documented for reproducible results.

pH.title: pH
pH.description: pH of the reaction mixture (typically in pH units)

temperature.title: temperature
temperature.description: Temperature of the reaction mixture (typically in °C)

Enzyme.title: Enzyme
Enzyme.description: An enzyme is a biological catalyst, typically a protein, that facilitates and accelerates specific chemical reactions by lowering the activation energy required. Enzymes are highly specific to their substrates and play crucial roles in metabolic pathways and biotechnological applications.

initial_concentration.title: initial_concentration
initial_concentration.description: Starting concentration of the enzyme in the reaction mixture (typically in mg/mL or μM)

name.title: name
name.description: Enzyme name, EC number, or protein identifier from databases like UniProt

role.title: role
role.description: Role of the enzyme in the reaction (enzyme, cofactor, inhibitor)

Molecule.title: Molecule
Molecule.description: A molecule represents a chemical compound or substrate involved in the biological reaction, including both reactants and products. This encompasses small molecules, cofactors, inhibitors, and any other chemical species that participate in or influence the enzymatic process.

initial_concentration.title: initial_concentration
initial_concentration.description: Starting concentration of the molecule in the reaction mixture (typically in mM or μM)

name.title: name
name.description: Chemical name or identifier (IUPAC name, common name, or database ID)

role.title: role
role.description: Role of the molecule in the reaction (substrate, product, cofactor, inhibitor)
